actions.authority: district administration (Office of Teaching & Learning + ITS); later listed by ISBE as a model policy
actions.summary: Published an AI Guidebook: students use district-approved AI tools with teacher permission, teachers encouraged to integrate AI with age-appropriate guidance; 2024-25 a learning year, full implementation 2025-26.
actions.notes: Release date is approximate (coverage dated 2024-08-16 says 'last week'). Counter-current worth watching: in August 2026 Illinois Families for Public Schools asked candidates for Chicago's first fully elected school board to pledge a three-year generative-AI moratorium; about two dozen signed. Enrollment figure is approximate.
